name: dpdpa-india
description: Audit an application, codebase, product, or data flow for compliance with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 and the DPDP Rules 2025. Ships the statutory text, penalty schedule, a section-by-section audit checklist, codebase detection patterns, GDPR↔DPDP mapping, and ready-reference policy templates. Engineering aid, not legal advice.
